name: superpowers
description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
one_liner: A process pack that forces an AI coding assistant to first ask what you actually want, then plan, then write tests before code, instead of rushing straight into writing software.
buyer: A software consultancy owner who sells 'AI-accelerated development' to clients and needs a repeatable, trustworthy process to point to instead of ad-hoc vibe coding.
business_use_cases: A dev shop adopts it as their standard methodology so every client engagement follows the same spec-first, test-driven process regardless of which engineer runs it.
A startup's single engineer uses it to let an AI agent work autonomously for hours on a feature without drifting off the agreed plan.
A coding bootcamp licenses the methodology (with permission/attribution) as the backbone of an 'AI-assisted engineering' course module.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid onboarding/training for engineering teams adopting this workflow, since it changes how a team runs projects.
Build a companion dashboard-as-a-service that tracks spec/plan/test compliance across a team's repos.

steal_this: It's free and already popular (300k+ stars), so there's no product to resell — the real weekend move is becoming visibly good at it and selling 'we build with Superpowers' as a trust signal to clients.
